id: Would you like to take Corphish with you?
en: Would you like to take Corphish with you?

id: \bHow did you get back here? Hm, I guess the path is too easy to find nowadays. I'll have to change it.
en: \bHow did you get back here? Hm, I guess the path is too easy to find nowadays. I'll have to change it.
it: \bCome sei arrivato fin qui? Mm, a quanto pare il passaggio è troppo facile da trovare di questi tempi. Dovrò cambiarlo.

id: \bWell since you did manage to find this place, how would you like to take one of the older Mudkip that I can't keep any longer?
en: \bWell since you did manage to find this place, how would you like to take one of the older Mudkip that I can't keep any longer?
it: \bBeh, visto che sei riuscito a trovare questo posto, che ne dici di prendere uno dei Mudkip più grandi che non posso più tenere?

id: \bDon't stay around too long. You may scare them.
en: \bDon't stay around too long. You may scare them.

id: \bBrock: Hey \PN! What are you doing in Hoenn?
en: \bBrock: Hey \PN! What are you doing in Hoenn?
it: \bBrock: Ehi, \PN! Che ci fai a Hoenn?

id: \bGym battles. I should have guessed. I'm trying to expand myself as a Breeder. A good battle will help with that.
en: \bGym battles. I should have guessed. I'm trying to expand myself as a Breeder. A good battle will help with that.
it: \bLotte in Palestra. Avrei dovuto immaginarlo. Io sto cercando di crescere come Allevatore. Una bella lotta mi aiuterà.

id: \bBrock: Thanks. I learned a lot from that battle. I'll see you around.
en: \bBrock: Thanks. I learned a lot from that battle. I'll see you around.
it: \bBrock: Grazie. Ho imparato molto da questa lotta. Ci vediamo in giro.
